measurements.evidence_quote: Zeta potential measurements for microplastics and LiquidBots in deionized water were taken with a Malvern Zetasizer Ultra, with triplicate runs to assess error. || A magnetic setup was used for navigation and adsorption experiments with amino‐modified PS microplastics (Merck, 2 µm) under a 3 mT magnetic field at 1 Hz.
measurements.evidence_location: Methods, Characterization of LiquidBots; LiquidBots Capture of Microplastics

measurements.evidence_quote: First, the Zeta potential of PEG 4000 was tested, revealing that PEG 4000 carries a positive charge in water, whereas LiquidBots carry a negative charge (Figure S6, Supporting Information). || Zeta potential measurements for microplastics and LiquidBots in deionized water were taken with a Malvern Zetasizer Ultra, with triplicate runs to assess error.
